{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Rich cream cashmere wrap coat, relaxed drape cut, knee-length, hex #F5F0E6, soft wool blend.
Tailored high-neck blouse, structured fit, long sleeves, ivory white, fine poplin cotton.
Straight-leg wide trousers, clean silhouette, ankle length, charcoal grey, heavy weight wool flannel.
Leather loafers with a slight heel, rounded toe, chestnut brown, smooth calfskin leather.
Delicate gold bar necklace and a structured tweed clutch in burnt orange to complement the autumn library setting.

This outfit works perfectly because it balances the intellectual charm of an old library with the warmth needed for cold weather, ensuring you stay comfortable while standing in line or sitting by the window. The rich textures like cashmere and heavy wool flannel are ideal for a photoshoot where you want to feel recognized on camera without losing elegance. Finally, the sophisticated smart dress code suits the post-presentation celebration, allowing you to transition seamlessly from a book signing to an evening of friendship while maintaining a stylish silhouette that feels both cozy and polished."}
